jobs.title: Flutter and Laravel Developer to Complete a Ferry Booking App

- All code delivered to our GitHub repository, with all accounts owned by us
- Weekly demo builds and clear written updates

jobs.title: AI Automation Developer for Drywall Estimating & GoHighLevel Proposal System
jobs.description:
AI Automation Developer Needed: Email-to-Estimate Proposal System for Drywall Contractor

We are looking for an experienced AI automation developer to build an email-to-estimate workflow for a drywall company.

The goal is to automatically receive construction bid-request emails with plan/specification PDFs, analyze the documents using Claude AI, apply the company's estimating rules and pricing, create a draft estimate/proposal, and send it to the estimator for approval before it goes to the customer.

Workflow Needed
1. A customer/GC emails plan sets, drawings, and specifications as PDF attachments.
2. The automation detects the email and creates or updates a contact/opportunity in GoHighLevel.
3. PDF attachments are pulled into the automation.
4. Claude AI analyzes the plans/specs and extracts relevant drywall-estimating information.
5. The automation applies the drywall company's provided pricing rules, labor rates, material costs, waste percentage, markup, and minimum pricing.
6. It creates a structured draft estimate and branded proposal PDF.
7. It sends the estimator an internal approval request.
8. Once approved, GoHighLevel automatically sends the proposal to the customer/GC and tracks follow-up.

Required Tech Stack
- GoHighLevel / LeadConnector
- Make.com or n8n
- Claude API / Anthropic API
- PDF/OCR/document processing experience
- Webhooks and API integrations
- Proposal/PDF document generation
- CRM custom fields, opportunities, pipelines, and workflows

Important Requirements
- The system must use the drywall company's specific pricing rules and estimating guidelines.
- AI should return structured data/JSON, not only a written summary.
- The proposal must never automatically send without estimator approval.
- If plans are incomplete, unclear, or low-confidence, the system should flag the job for manual review.
- Build the workflow so it can be repeated for additional drywall/construction clients in the future.
- Keep client data secure and provide clear documentation/training after setup.

jobs.title: Senior AI Automation Engineer — Rebuild Operations for an Established Business
jobs.description:
We run an established, document-intensive service business and are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us operate with significantly less manual work.

We already use AI in production. However, employees still move documents between systems, prepare templates, check outputs, coordinate approvals, and handle customer communication. We believe much of this work can be automated, with a smaller team managing exceptions and quality.

We want someone who can understand the operation, challenge how it currently works, and build the systems to improve it.

The work

You'll design and implement automation across workflows involving:

Customer support through email, live chat, and occasional calls.

Document intake, OCR, classification, and structured data extraction.

AI processing, rule-based calculations, and template-based document generation.

External reviewer coordination, approvals, signatures, and delivery.

Order tracking, paid physical fulfillment, and related administrative tasks.

Sales support and contract coordination.

Specific services and internal workflows will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

Who we're looking for

You have shipped AI systems that handle real business work, and you understand what happens when inputs are incomplete, outputs are wrong, or integrations fail.

You should be able to:

Choose the right model for each task based on accuracy, latency, cost, and privacy.

Decide where to use LLMs, deterministic code, workflow automation, or human review.

Build reliable integrations with APIs, databases, document tools, and communication platforms.

Create quality checks, evaluation datasets, exception queues, retries, and monitoring.

Handle sensitive customer documents with appropriate access controls and audit trails.

Own the work from discovery through deployment.

Strong full-stack skills are essential. Experience with TypeScript/React, Python, Supabase/Postgres, OCR, and document generation is useful.

What success looks like

We want fewer manual touches per order, faster turnaround, consistent quality, and a measurable reduction in staff hours required to run the business.

The first engagement will be a paid assessment and implementation of one high-impact workflow. If successful, we'll expand across the operation. There is potential for an ongoing technical leadership role.
